hooks.name: core-property-tests
hooks.description: After the agent edits cryptography, cards or the watch schedule, run their property tests.

hooks.name: watch-service-tests
hooks.description: After the agent edits the watch service, run its tests with the fake clock.

hooks.name: offline-guard
hooks.description: Keep the promise that nothing but the watch client and the mail adapter can reach a network.

hooks.name: fast-checks-before-done
hooks.description: Before the agent says it is done: types, lint, the offline guard and all unit tests.

action.command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:offline && npm test
